resources.string: Plays FLAC, Opus, AAC, MP3 and WAV. IAMF plays only inside MP4, and only where the device has an IAMF decoder.
This is a raw .iamf stream. Spatia can play IAMF only when it is packaged in an MP4 file.
This file contains IAMF immersive audio, but this device has no IAMF decoder. IAMF decoding is built into some devices running Android 16 or later.
This format isn\'t supported. Supported formats: FLAC, Opus, AAC, MP3, WAV and IAMF in MP4.
This doesn\'t look like an audio file.
Unrecognised file type. Supported formats: FLAC, Opus, AAC, MP3, WAV and IAMF in MP4.
This device has no decoder for the audio in this file.
The file is damaged or uses a container Spatia can\'t read.
Spatia can\'t open the file anymore. Pick it again.
Hear the original at matched loudness, so louder doesn\'t just sound better.
Saved separately for each output. Now editing: %1$s
Puts virtual speakers around your head using a head-shadow model. Works best with headphones. Applies to the built-in player only.
Turns stereo into virtual 5.0: centre plus rear ambience.
Keeps the sound fixed in the room as you turn your head.
No head-tracking sensor found. Connect headphones that support head tracking.
Evens out level differences between tracks. Uses ReplayGain tags when the file has them.
Quiet parts get louder and loud parts quieter, for low-volume listening.
Restores bass and treble at low volume, following the ear\'s equal-loudness curves.
Blends a little of each channel into the other ear, like speakers in a room, to ease fatigue from hard-panned mixes. Headphones only, with spatial audio off.
Phone speaker only. Adds harmonics so you hear deep bass the speaker can\'t physically play, without overdriving it.
Import a parametric EQ file (AutoEq or EqualizerAPO text format) to correct your headphones\' frequency response. The file is read once and stays on your device.
Load a WAV impulse response (up to 2 s, mono or stereo) to place the music in a real room. It\'s held in memory only.
A short listening check builds a gentle compensation curve (at most +6 dB). It isn\'t a medical test, and the results stay on this device.

Sit somewhere quiet and set your volume to a comfortable middle level. Don\'t change it during the check. You\'ll hear quiet tones in one ear at a time. Tap \"Heard it\" as soon as you can hear the tone.
Safety for this output: at most %1$.0f dB boost, limiter ceiling %2$.0f dBFS, volume warning above %3$d%%.
Each pair of headphones keeps its own settings. Devices are recognised by type and model name, never by hardware address.
Sends audio to your USB DAC unchanged. All Spatia processing (EQ, spatial, limiter) is bypassed while this is on, so use the DAC\'s own volume carefully.
Estimates headphone exposure against the WHO safe-listening guideline (80 dB for 40 hours a week). It\'s an estimate from the volume setting, not a measurement, and it stays on this device.
This week: %1$d%% of the safe weekly dose
Listening at high volume through headphones for long periods can permanently damage your hearing.
The volume is very high. Long exposure at this level can harm your hearing.

Spatia can enhance other apps only when they announce their audio session to equaliser apps. Many music players do. Most streaming, video, game and call apps don\'t, and Android offers no documented way to process them.

Available here: EQ, bass and treble, voice clarity, loudness compensation, headphone correction, night compression, per-app boost and limiter. Spatial 3D, head tracking, crossfeed and room effects work in the built-in player only.
No app has announced an audio session yet. Start playback in a supported app.
Enhanced with EQ, dynamics and limiter
Basic equaliser only. Boost is disabled because this device has no limiter effect.
Couldn\'t attach. The app or device refused the effect.
Boost is limited to %1$.0f dB for this output and always runs through the limiter.
Applies to apps that announce their audio session.
Every sound feature works on all supported Android versions.
This device or output doesn\'t offer the platform spatializer. Spatia\'s own spatial audio still works.
Available but turned off in system settings.
Available and on for supported multichannel content.
Available in the built-in player on every device.
Works for apps that announce their audio session. Uses DynamicsProcessing.
Works for apps that announce their audio session, with a basic EQ only. No boost, because there\'s no limiter.
This device exposes no audio effects to apps.
Not possible. Android doesn\'t let apps process other apps\' audio samples.
The connected USB device supports bit-perfect playback.
The connected USB device doesn\'t support bit-perfect playback.
The platform has an IAMF decoder. IAMF in MP4 plays with the built-in player.
No IAMF decoder on this device. Some devices add one with Android 16.
Allowed. The system-wide service notification will show.
Denied. System-wide enhancement still works, but its notification is hidden.
The USB device refused bit-perfect mode.
Change applies from the next track.
